source: A michael jackson game. where its a concert of Michael Jackson's and hes singing on stage

image_prompt.text: A large concert stage as the hero build, composed to be framed from anywhere on the floor in front of it
An open standing area in front of the stage where the audience gathers to watch
Players arrive facing the stage, so the first thing they see is the performance rather than backstage geometry
Michael Jackson on stage with a microphone, singing to the crowd

layout_placement.text: Spawn placed in the crowd area and oriented toward the stage
Small optional finds tucked around the edges of the venue

notes: Classified as a place rather than a rhythm game: there is a stage, a performer and a crowd, so it builds instead of routing to P5.
The named real performer is the entire subject of the prompt and there is no option for a character or performer; it is carried as free text in the image stream.

open_questions.ask: Which era and venue - a 1980s stadium show, an intimate theatre, a modern arena?
Do players do anything here - dance, join the crowd, get on stage - or is it purely somewhere to watch?

coverage_missing.ask: Which era and venue should the concert read as?
Small club, theatre, or a stadium crowd?
Is there anything for the player to do, or is watching the point?

answers.ask: Which era and venue - a 1980s stadium show, an intimate theatre, a modern arena?
answers.answer: Use a 1980s stadium show, matching Michael Jackson's classic concert era.

answers.ask: Do players do anything here - dance, join the crowd, get on stage - or is it purely somewhere to watch?
answers.answer: Players join the crowd and can dance while watching the performance; they do not go on stage.
